programme.title: Son of the Dragon
programme.desc: In the spectacular tradition of the Sonar Entertainment classics Merlin & Arabian Nights comes a magically splendid adventure for everyone. Devil Boy (John Reardon, Merlin's Apprentice), abandoned at birth and rescued from the docks of Shanghai to grow into an adventurous young thief, steals to provide food for the street children he considers his family. Now the clever lad and his faithful companion Bird (Golden Globe nominee David Carradine, Kill Bill) have their eyes on swindling the royal court of its jewels. The best way to do it is by winning the hand of the Governor's daughter, Princess Li Wei (Desiree Siahaan, Marco Polo) with whom he is immediately & genuinely smitten. As luck would have it, she's being presented with potential suitors. There is formidable competition with the Prince of the North (Rupert Graves) who is the choice for the Governor. The Princess, secretly attracted to D.B., manages to convince her father to arrange challenges for all her suitors. The Princess sends along her companion, an accomplished sword master, Ting Ting (Theresa Lee, Stargate SG-1), disguised as a man to keep D.B. safe. What the Princess does not know is that Ting Ting comes from the same "street" family as D.B., & that she is in love with him. Framed for attempting to poison the Princess, D.B. and Bird are condemned to death. In the last moment, a guilt-ridden Ting Ting helps D.B. break free from the dungeon, safeguard the royal family, and claim Li Wei's hand in marriage as his own. But it takes the faith of Bird, a magical flying carpet, and the mystical Fruit of Life for D.B. and Li Wei to see their dream to the end. Sonar Entertainment invites you on a wild ride like no other--filled with dazzling romance, stirring action, and breathtaking suspense.

programme.title: Son of the Dragon
programme.desc: Son of Dragon is a two-part mini series that retells the Arabian Night's story of "The Thief of Bagdad" setting it in ancient China. The story follows a young man, Devil Boy, who was abandoned at birth. He grows up to become a thief to provide for street children he considers family. Together with his faithful friend and teacher, Bird, he has a plan to rob the royal court of Shanghai. But there he falls in love with the daughter of the Governor, Princess Li Wei. To win over her hand he has to compete against other potential suitors in various challenges set by by the Governor.

programme.title: King Solomon's Mines

The main character (Swayze), is called Allan Quatermain and is a treasure hunter in search this time, of King Solomon's hidden treasure. With the help of a group of people, one of which is a woman trying to locate her father, Sir Henry, who went missing years ago, they embark on the dangerous journey. On their coat tails is a group of hostile and violent African tribesmen and a fellow explorer.

La Liga is one of the most popular professional sports leagues in the world and the top league in Europe over the last five years.

programme.title: Savage Kingdom
programme.desc: The sparse African Savannah can be a fearsome place for both herds of powerful prey and the lurking predators who hunt them down. In this captivating documentary series from National Geographic, the relationship between predator and prey is closely examined, exploring the fight for survival for both sets of animals. These herds are full of powerful or agile animals, making the job of a predator to feed itself and its family a troublesome task. But the African predators are ruthless and proficient hunters, and if a herd is infiltrated, or a straggling member is targeted, they will struggle to evade these savage carnivores.

programme.title: Cannibal Sharks
programme.desc: Two of the world's greatest shark experts are examining evidence that sharks attack each other far more often than we ever thought.

programme.title: Sharks of the North
programme.desc: Sightings of great white sharks have been on the rise in Atlantic Canada. Alanna Canaran, a passionate science educator and dive instructor, embarks on a mission to unravel the enigmas surrounding these magnificent creatures and is determined to dispel fear of sharks in Nova Scotians. As the journey unfolds, Canaran and her team dive into the history of human-shark relationships along the coast. Facing numerous challenges, including elusive sharks and treacherous weather conditions, the team perseveres. With sheer determination and a stroke of luck, they gather invaluable knowledge of these magnificent creatures, contributing to a better understanding of white sharks in Canada.

programme.title: Wild Mississippi
programme.desc: North America's most famous waterway, the Mississippi River, is explored in this fantastic documentary series, focussing on the vast numbers of animals that depend on it for survival. With stunning cinematography that highlights its beauty and size, Wild Mississippi reveals the diverse climates and landscapes this enormous waterway covers, with its basin stretching for thousands of miles. A three-part series, each episode focusses on a unique aspect of the river, whether it's the cold, frozen birth as it falls south from the northern states, the floods it causes, both beneficial and detrimental to animals and humans alike, as well as its negative effects, such as the masses of fertiliser it carries into the Gulf of Mexico.

programme.title: Africa's Deadly Kingdom
programme.desc: Instead of providing in-depth examinations of the fauna of the continent of Africa, this nature series alternatively focuses on the hostile and unforgiving landscapes that the animals have to survive in. Africa is home to some of the most extreme and diverse environments on the planet, from arid deserts to lush rainforests, mountainous peaks to mighty river and lake systems, savannah grasslands to rugged coastline. This show explores these different regions and documents how the plants and creatures that inhabit them endure places where there are few resources of food and water or where competition is rife and life-threatening. The unique demands placed on these plants and animals have resulted in the development of incredibly resilient species that remain successful against all the odds.

Along with a bunch of friends they all live as one big happy family. Skateboarding Ronnie Anne also starts to explore what their new hometown has to offer. Meanwhile, Bobby helps his grandfather Hector working in the family store where they meet lots of interesting characters from the neighbourhood.

programme.title: The Penguins of Madagascar
programme.desc: "The Most Dangerous Game Night:Marlene plans a game night to help the zoo animals bond but it takes a terrible turn when the snacks run out. While Kowalski, Maurice, and Mort go on a snack run the gaming animals begin to fight over the games - cheating, sore losing, unwilling participation… chaos! The penguins think Max has met his slobbery doom in the jaws of the giant mastiff.".

programme.title: The Penguins of Madagascar

But even an infinite playland like this can't last forever! Our Man in Grrfurjiclestan: Special Agent Buck Rockgut makes a "triumphant" return. They battle each other to a standstill to uncover the agent - will it tear the unit apart? Can trust ever be restored? They have to take a trip to a faraway borough to uncover the truth.".

programme.title: Bubble Guppies
programme.desc: The series Bubble Guppies revolves around the underwater adventures of a group of mermaid-like preschoolers who life in the fictional underwater city of Bubbletucky. The owner of the shop will asks questions about what he or she needs. Later, Mr. Grouper comes into the shop and says it's time for lunch, and the "Lunchtime" song plays. At lunch the characters make a food joke about the subject of the episode. After lunch, another Gil and Molly sketch is shown. The Guppies do something fun which leads Mr. Grouper talking more about the topic, which leads into a dancing song. Mr. Grouper then says it's time to go outside, the "Outside" song plays, and the Guppies make up a story about the topic. After this, Gil and Molly do another sketch.The Guppies go on a field trip that focuses on the topic, and the show concludes with the last Gil and Molly sketch and a shorter version of the theme song.

programme.title: The Casagrandes
programme.desc: Family-orientated cartoon for kids. Ronnie Anne Santiago, her big brother Bobby and their mum have recently moved to Great Lakes City and are now getting used to life in this busy, and sometimes chaotic, new town. Here in the big city they meet the Casagrandes – their extended family made up of grandparents, aunt, uncle, cousins and their pets. Along with a bunch of friends they all live as one big happy family. Skateboarding Ronnie Anne also starts to explore what their new hometown has to offer. Meanwhile, Bobby helps his grandfather Hector working in the family store where they meet lots of interesting characters from the neighbourhood.

programme.desc: Simon West ('Con Air') dirige Nicolas Cage in un action con Josh Lucas e Malin Akerman. Durante una rapina qualcuno lo ha tradito, cosi' Will Montgomery si e' fatto qualche anno di carcere. Il bottino non e' mai stato recuperato, ma il suo vecchio socio e' convinto che Will sappia dove sia finito. E per recuperarlo ha un solo modo per convincerlo a collaborare: rapisce sua figlia Allison e la tiene prigioniera nel bagagliaio di un taxi. Se vuole rivedere la ragazza sana e salva, Will deve trovare 10 milioni di dollari in 12 ore.

Dopo aver commesso un imperdonabile errore, un giovane e ambizioso impiegato di una multinazionale ha la possibilita' di riabilitarsi agli occhi del suo capo e salvare il posto. Ma il boss in realta' lo ricatta, costringendolo a farsi assumere dalla societa' concorrente per rubare il prototipo di un nuovo prodotto. Dalla padella nella brace, si accorgera' di essere la semplice pedina di uno sporco gioco.

programme.title: Il grande Gatsby
programme.desc: Baz Luhrmann (il regista di "Mouline Rouge!") dirige Leonardo DiCaprio, Carey Mulligan e Tobey Maguire nello sfarzoso adattamento, vincitore di due Oscar, del celebre romanzo di Francis S. Fitzgerald, pilastro della letteratura statunitense. America, anni '20: un aspirante scrittore, Nick Carraway, entra nel mondo di Jay Gatsby, un misterioso milionario ossessionato dall'amore impossibile per Daisy: la donna da lui amata e che vorrebbe riconquistare. Nick verra' a contatto con l'atmosfera festosa dell'eta' del jazz che si consuma in illusioni, malinconie e sogni effimeri.

programme.title: Every Breath You Take - Senza respiro
programme.desc: Thriller Sky Original con Casey Affleck, Sam Claflin e Michelle Monaghan. Il suicidio di una paziente compromette l'equilibrio familiare di uno psichiatra.

programme.title: Notre-Dame in fiamme
programme.desc: La pellicola Sky Original di Jean-Jacques Annaud sull'incendio che colpi' la cattedrale parigina nel 2019 e su coloro che sfidarono le fiamme per mettere in salvo tesori inestimabili.

programme.desc: Biopic diretto da Clint Eastwood con Angelina Jolie. Los Angeles, 1928: una donna afferma che il bambino che le hanno riportato dopo un rapimento non è suo figlio, ma nessuno le crede.

programme.desc: David Cronenberg dirige Viggo Mortensen in un thriller fra apparenza e realtà. Dopo aver ucciso 2 rapinatori per legittima difesa, un uomo si trova braccato da loschi individui.

programme.title: L'arminuta
programme.desc: 1 David di Donatello al film di Giuseppe Bonito dal bestseller di Donatella Di Pietrantonio. Una tredicenne torna dalla sua famiglia biologica, passando da una vita agiata alla poverta'.

programme.title: Attrazione fatale
programme.desc: Passione pericolosa fra Glenn Close e Michael Douglas in un cult degli anni '80, firmato dal regista di "9 settimane e 1/2". Dan Gallagher, un avvocato di New York felicemente sposato, tradisce la moglie con una sconosciuta, che non si accontenta di una sola notte e comincia a perseguitarlo rendendogli la vita un inferno. Le provocazioni della psicopatica si fanno sempre piu' asfissianti, fino a quando la donna comunica a Dan di essere incinta, rifiutandosi di abortire. La sua prossima sfida sara' recarsi a casa dell'uomo per conoscere la moglie...

programme.title: Il tenente ottomano

programme.desc: Valeria Bruni Tedeschi e Micaela Ramazzotti nel road movie al femminile di Paolo Virzì. Due donne fuggono da una clinica psichiatrica e si avventurano a riassaporare il mondo.

Considerata paranoica dalla polizia, Jill non ha altra scelta per uscire da quest'incubo: indagare da sola per trovare il rapitore di sua sorella prima che sia troppo tardi.

programme.desc: Prodotto da Michael Bay, un thriller che immagina un drammatico futuro. 2024: le continue mutazioni del Covid-19 hanno chiuso il mondo in un eterno lockdown. In questo scenario da incubo, Nico, immune al virus, è pronto a infrangere la legge per liberare la sua fidanzata dall'isolamento.

La principessa Anna giunge a Roma per una visita ufficiale. Nella Capitale incontra un reporter americano, sull'orlo del licenziamento, che le propone una 'vacanza alternativa', lontano dai rigidi e noiosi cerimoniali del protocollo. Fuggita da palazzo, vivra' una romantica avventura, scoprendo grazie al suo accompagnatore il vero volto della citta'. Ma i giornali sono sulle tracce della principessa e lo scoop e' in agguato...

programme.title: La casa sul lago del tempo

Arrivato nella sua nuova casa sul lago, Alex trova una lettera della precedente inquilina, Kate, con cui inizia un rapporto epistolare. I due continuano a scriversi e finiscono per innamorarsi, ma scoprono di non potersi incontrare perche' vivono in anni diversi: lui nel 2004, lei nel 2006. Ispirato a "Il mare", film coreano inedito in Italia diretto da Hyun-Seung Lee, con Sandra Bullock e Keanu Reeves che tornano a lavorare insieme 12 anni dopo "Speed".

Per lui non esistono relazioni stabili, tanto meno il matrimonio. E di questo cerca di convincere anche il fratello minore, che invece sta per sposarsi, ma i fantasmi delle sue numerose ex cominciano a perseguitarlo, mostrandogli quello che sarà il suo futuro. Nel cast, anche Michael Douglas.

programme.desc:
A story of a couple who preserves the family 
bakery business legacy from closure. Now the 
couple’s children, volunteers to step in and help the 
business. Are the parents willing to accept change

programme.title: Kurdapya ep 8
programme.desc: Kurdapya tells the story of long-lost twins, KURING \u0026 DAPHNE. They meet after a strange accident and discover that they lead extremely different lives. Kuring grew up with the cruel extended family in the province while Daphne is an undervalued publishing executive in the city. Both women want to get out of their current realities, so they decide to switch lives by pretending to be each other.

the underprivileged. After his mother was killed, he 
vowed to seek revenge against the influential 
retired judge, Benito Balmores.

programme.title: Justice League
programme.desc: Steppenwolf and his Parademons return after aeons to destroy Earth. However, Batman seeks the help of Wonder Woman to recruit The Flash, Cyborg and Aquaman to fight their new powerful enemy.

programme.title: Hercules
programme.desc: Hercules, a Greek demigod, is haunted by his past as he leads a band of mercenaries. One day, the king of Thrace seeks his help in protecting his kingdom from a tyrannical warlord.

programme.title: I Am Wrath
programme.desc: After corrupt cops are unable to catch his wife's killers, Stanley, an unemployed man, teams up with an old friend to avenge her death.

programme.title: Hunt to Kill
programme.desc: A gang of thugs hold captive a US Border Patrol agent and his daughter in the wilderness.

programme.title: The Kid
programme.desc: After a woman abandons her child, the Tramp finds him and takes him under his wing. As the boy grows up, the Tramp and the boy try to cope with life's trials and tribulations.

programme.title: The Giver
programme.desc: Jonas, a young man, trains under an elder in order to become the keeper of his community's memories. However, things get complicated once he discovers the sinister side of his city.

programme.title: Lady Bloodfight
programme.desc: Jane, an American girl travelling in Hong Kong, gets into a physical altercation with three robbers where she defends herself. A martial artist, who observes the event, trains her for a competition.

programme.title: Sabotage
programme.desc: John Wharton, the captain of an elite task force, raids a safe house owned by one of the most lethal drug cartels with his team. Though the mission is successful, death awaits them.

programme.title: Spectre
programme.desc: James Bond, the renowned spy, gets a cryptic message from an evil organisation. However, things quickly become complicated when he tries to unravel the mystery.

programme.title: Now You See Me
programme.desc: Four magicians who perform on streets steal a tremendous amount of money that belongs to an insurance magnate while they are pursued by police authorities.

programme.title: Justice League
programme.desc: Steppenwolf and his Parademons return after aeons to destroy Earth. However, Batman seeks the help of Wonder Woman to recruit The Flash, Cyborg and Aquaman to fight their new powerful enemy.

programme.title: Tomorrow Never Dies
programme.desc: James Bond, an undercover agent, sets out to prevent a media baron, Elliot Carver, from waging a war between China and the United Kingdom after he gets summoned by the Secret Intelligence Service.

programme.title: Shazam!
programme.desc: After being abandoned at a fair, Billy constantly searches for his mother. His life, however, takes a huge turn when he inherits superpowers from a powerful wizard.

programme.title: Hansel & Gretel: Witch Hunters
programme.desc: Brother-sister duo Hansel and Gretel are professional witch hunters who help innocent villagers. But they soon stumble upon a case that could hold the key to their past.

programme.title: Apocalypto
programme.desc: A mettlesome tribesman must do whatever it takes to protect himself and his family from a multitude of threats during the Mayan civilisation's waning years.
